title: The Retreat: Relax & Unwind in Comfort
description:
Enjoy a stylish stay in this spacious townhome with a cozy fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, and central heating & cooling. With free parking for 2 cars and a prime location just minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, and top attractions, it’s the perfect home base for your Nashville trip. Whether you’re here for live music, great food, or a weekend getaway, you’ll love the comfort and convenience. Book now and explore Music City!

The space
Welcome to your perfect Nashville getaway! This charming 3-bedroom, 3-bath townhome offers everything you need for a comfortable stay. With a spacious living area, a cozy fireplace, and modern amenities, you'll feel right at home. The townhome features central heating and cooling, ensuring comfort year-round. Plus, there's parking for two cars in the rear, making it easy to come and go.

Located just minutes from the heart of Nashville, you'll have quick access to local attractions, dining, and entertainment. Whether you're here for a weekend of fun or a longer stay, this townhome offers the ideal base for your Nashville adventure.

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you prior to your reservation.

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
